parts.name: Insulated cold plunge tub with insulated lid (Elecpluway XL, 53 x 33 x 26 in)
parts.notes: Search 'Elecpluway XL cold plunge tub'. Price not shown on the listing when checked; ~$160 is an estimate. Any insulated tub with a lid and a rim wall 50-110 mm thick works with the rim manifold; its own drain valve stays usable.

parts.name: Active Aqua AACH50HP 1/2 HP water chiller (ETL listed)
parts.notes: ETL reg. 4006823, 120 V 5.4 A, 4,020 BTU/h, 39-90 F, needs 800-1600 GPH flow, 10 psi max. Includes 1/2, 3/4 and 1 in barbs: use the 3/4 in pair. Last tracked Amazon price $934 (Feb 2026).

parts.name: Danner Mag-Drive 12 inline pump, 1200 GPH (UL listed)
parts.notes: Used IN-LINE on the cart, never in the tub. 110 W 1.5 A, 3/4 in FPT inlet / MPT outlet, ~880 GPH at 3 ft head.

parts.name: 10 in x 2.5 in water filter housing, 3/4 in NPT, with mounting bracket
parts.notes: Search '10 inch filter housing 3/4 NPT bracket'. Bracket bolts to the cart's filter bar with 2 x M5 + T-nuts.

parts.name: Pleated 50 micron filter cartridge 10 x 2.5 in, 2-pack
parts.notes: Search 'pleated sediment filter 10 x 2.5 50 micron washable'. Rinse weekly.

parts.name: 3/4 in ID PVC spiral suction hose, 15 ft
parts.notes: Search '3/4 inch spiral suction hose 15 ft'. Kink resistant. Cut with a utility knife into: rim-to-filter 1.0 m, filter-to-pump 0.45 m, pump-to-chiller 0.45 m, chiller-to-rim 1.0 m, suction drop 0.28 m, return drop 0.21 m.

parts.name: Foam pipe insulation for 1 in OD tube, 6 ft (3 pack)
parts.notes: Slip over the four dry hose runs to stop condensation drips and heat gain.

parts.name: 3/4 in MPT x 3/4 in hose barb, brass (4 pack)
parts.notes: Filter in + out, pump inlet, tee run. Wrap threads with PTFE tape.

parts.name: 3/4 in brass tee FPT + 3/4 in ball valve + 3/4 in MPT to garden hose adapter (drain)
parts.notes: On the pump outlet. To drain: switch the chiller off in the app, fold-clamp the chiller hose, open the valve and the pump empties the tub into a garden hose.

parts.name: Stainless worm-gear hose clamps #12, 15 pack
parts.notes: One on every barb (11 used).

parts.name: PTFE thread seal tape
Shelly Plug US Gen4 smart plug (UL listed, 15 A)
parts.notes: Search 'Shelly Plug US Gen4'. One for the chiller (5.4 A), one for the pump (1.5 A). Controlled over local Wi-Fi by the ESP32; no wiring to them.

parts.name: GFCI 3-outlet pigtail cord, 12/3, 15 A, UL listed
parts.notes: Search 'GFCI pigtail 3 outlet 12/3 UL'. Everything plugs into this, even if the wall outlet is already GFCI. Press TEST before every plunge.

parts.name: DS18B20 waterproof probe
parts.notes: Search 'DS18B20 waterproof stainless 3m'. 3 m cable, 3.3 V signal only.

parts.name: DS18B20 adapter module
parts.notes: Search 'DS18B20 adapter module terminal' (4.7k pull-up, screw terminal, 3-pin header). Often bundled with the probe. Stick to the pod floor with foam tape.

parts.name: Dupont jumper wires female-female, 20 cm (40 pack)
parts.notes: 3 used.

parts.name: USB power adapter 5 V 1 A (UL listed)
parts.notes: Plugs into the GFCI pigtail.

parts.name: Micro-USB cable, 3 m
parts.notes: Adapter to ESP32 DevKitC; route with a drip loop.

parts.name: PG7 cable gland, nylon (10 pack)
parts.notes: Probe cable entry on the underside of the pod.

parts.name: M8 x 80 star knob clamping screw with swivel pad + M8 nut
parts.notes: Search 'M8 clamping screw swivel pad star knob 80mm'. Clamps the rim manifold to the tub wall.

parts.name: 2020 corner bracket kit with M5 screws and T-nuts (20 pack)
parts.notes: 12 used: 6 rail-to-cross-bar, 4 post-to-cross-bar, 2 filter-bar-to-post.

parts.name: M5 x 10 button head screw + M5 drop-in T-nut, 50 sets
parts.notes: Decks (12), splash shield (6), filter bracket (2), caster plates to rails (8), T-nuts for the pod's 2 screws.

parts.name: 2 in locking swivel plate casters (4 pack)
parts.notes: Plate hole pattern 38-56 mm fits the caster plates' radial slots.

parts.name: M6 x 16 bolt + nylock nut + washer, 20 sets
parts.notes: Casters to caster plates (16 used).

parts.name: Hook-and-loop cinch strap 25 mm x 40 cm (5 pack)
parts.notes: Holds the pump down through the pump deck slots.

parts.name: ESP32 DevKitC (WROOM-32, 38 pin)
parts.notes: search: ESP32 DevKitC WROOM-32 38 pin

parts.name: M3×10 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 10mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

parts.name: M5×10 button head screw
parts.notes: search: M5x10 button head screw
